profile.headline: SWE @ Citibank | UF CpE Alumni
profile.summary:
I am a University of Florida alumni that has worked as an undergraduate teaching assistant for Digital Logic in the Electrical and Computer Engineering Department.

I have also previously worked on a research project that is aiming to improve programming education in younger students through coding video games. My work involved modifying a game engine written in C++ and Lua.

positions.title: Apple Pathways Alliance Scholar
positions.description: • Building technical and networking skills with the guidance of Apple employees while learning about the way the company operates.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Facilitated an automated documentation program written in Java that organizes JSON code into readable pseudocode for ease of understanding by new or non-technical team members.
• Leveraged the existing codebase to derive attributes from the metadata, translated the data into
readable pseudocode, and output the values through a Rest API using Spring.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Java · Software Industry

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Instructing a group of 10+ students by reviewing and reinforcing course content.
• Assisting students with practical applications of the course content through programming in VHDL and FPGAs.

positions.title: MineTest Research Project
positions.description: • Worked on a code-based system that allows students in K-12 to learn programming languages through the development of mods in Minetest, a game similar to Minecraft.

positions.title: Citi Early ID Leadership Program
positions.description: • Learned about Citibank and gained technical knowledge through a training curriculum along with the mentorship of an ICG Technology Analyst.

positions.title: Microsoft Tech Resilience Program
positions.description: • Developed skills relating to mindset and resilience in the workplace from Microsoft software engineers.
positions.insights: Skills: Tech Resilience · Mindset · Team Building

positions.title: Employee
positions.description:
• Served over 200 customers per day through online, in-store, and drive-through orders, increasing
efficiency of product output while exhibiting quality customer service.

projects.title: Gator Field Notebook
projects.description:
• Constructed a multi-platform mobile application for use by field researchers collecting specimens of plants or animals.
• Leveraged the Google Maps API to automatically pull coordinates where a specimen was found, minimizing risk of inaccuracy with hand-written notes.
• Integrated Bluetooth printer functionality for portable label printing in the field for specimen.

projects.title: File System Project
projects.description:
• Created a working file system within a custom Unix-based OS that takes in .WAD files as input.
• Used the FUSE API to allow interaction with the written library using commands like nano, cd, ls, and cat.
